name: Remnant
description: Autonomous AI warships. Left behind from the First AI War.

name: Omega
description: Mysterious super-advanced AI. Beyond conventional understanding.

name: Hegemony
description: The largest military power in the Sector. Maintains order through force and tradition.

name: Tri-Tachyon
description: High-tech corporation. Cutting-edge phase technology and advanced warships.

name: Persean League
description: Alliance of independent worlds. Balanced fleet composition.

name: Sindrian Diktat
description: Authoritarian regime. Fanatical loyalty and Lion's Guard elite units.

name: Independent
description: Unaffiliated worlds and factions. Common civilian and freighter designs.

name: Pirates
description: Outlaw factions. Modified ships with more guns and less crew.

name: Luddic Church
description: Religious organization. Low-tech ships focused on durability and crew.

name: Luddic Path
description: Radical Luddite terrorists. Unsafe modifications and reckless tactics.

name: Lion's Guard
description: Sindrian Diktat elite forces. Upgraded ship variants with improved systems.

name: XIV Legion
description: Ancient Hegemony battle groups. Heavier armor and older, more durable designs.
